articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Metamaterial-Based Designs for 5G and Beyond Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: This study presents a performance analysis of a compact patch antenna that utilizes metamaterial (MTM) design techniques. The study also analyses the return loss parameters of the patch antenna to demonstrate improved antenna performance. The miniaturization of patch antennas is achieved by utilizing an MTM-based technique. Patch antennas are predominant in wireless communication systems but tend to occupy a lot of space. This technique requires combining MTM-inspired elements such as split-ring resonators (SRRs), fractal structures, or loaded inductive loops into the structure of the patch antenna. These elements are fabricated sensitively to communicate with the electromagnetic (EM) waves to decrease the antenna’s size whilst preserving its performance attributes. The proposed MTM-based technique promises several advantages, such as compact antenna designs, enhanced efficiency, radiation pattern characteristics, and bandwidth. In summary, the size miniaturization of patch antennas utilizing the MTM-based approach investigates the combination of metamaterial structures in the design of patch antennas. The technique seeks to achieve miniaturization while maintaining good antenna performance. Furthermore, this approach holds significant prospects for enabling the deployment of compact, efficient, and high-performance antennas in various wireless communication applications.

articleTitle: Seasonal Forest Disaster Prediction using Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: The forests are natural barriers that help prevent natural disasters such as heavy rainfall, heavy winds, etc. Because these disasters affect the forest, they make way for more disasters in surrounding areas including other forests, affecting animals, cities, and villages, especially tribal populations. This project aims to find solutions by analyzing the forest and its historical data including disaster incidents. The Seasonal Forest Disaster Analysis project harnesses advanced Machine Learning to investigate and mitigate the impact of forest disasters comprehensively. In essence, the Seasonal Forest Disaster Analysis project stands as a testament to the potential of cutting-edge technology and collaborative efforts in tackling some of the most pressing challenges facing our natural world. The Seasonal Forest Disaster Analysis project is a comprehensive endeavor that harnesses advanced Machine Learning & Deep Learning techniques to deeply investigate and mitigate the impact of forest disasters. Three models like CNN with Grad-CAM, ResNet and XceptionNet were proposed, out of which CNN with Grad-CAM produces an Accuracy of 94 %. By integrating a diverse array of datasets, including satellite imagery, climate data, and historical records, the project is geared towards effectively identifying, categorizing, and predicting a spectrum of seasonal forest disasters, including but not limited to wildfires, droughts, and floods. This integration enables the creation of a sophisticated framework that not only examines past occurrences but also foresees potential future hazards through predictive modelling.

Author Keywords: Image Datasets of Various Forest Disasters

articleTitle: Trans-SegNet - Deep Transfer Learning Approach to Detect Abnormalities in Microscopic Blood Smear Images for Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Medical image segmentation is very important for detecting illness and treatment in a precise manner. The diseases like leukemia, malaria, and other blood disorders identification mainly depends on the anomalies segmentation in microscopic blood smear images. Traditional methods for medical image segmentation are laborious to unpredictability because they need a frequent domain-specific expertise and manual intervention. The study provides a novel method to segment microscopic blood smears using Trans-SegNet, a deep transfer learning algorithm. By using pre-trained Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), the proposed method transfer learned features efficiently to the blood smear analysis domain, so that segmentation accuracy can be improved. A pre-trained CNN is fine-tuned using blood smear images properties and for accurate segmentation, the proposed method uses a Fully Convolutional Network (FCN). Experimentation uses publicly accessible blood smear image dataset and results show that the proposed method outperforms traditional segmentation techniques. The Trans-SegNet obtained an Intersection over Union (IoU) of 89.7% and Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 92.5%. Furthermore, precision with 91.3% and recall with 90.8% were recorded.

articleTitle: Enhanced Colon Cancer Screening with Endoscopic Images Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Colon cancer is a leading cause of cancer- related deaths worldwide, where early detection is vital for improving outcomes. This study focuses on a deep-learning approach for detecting colon cancer using endoscopy images. By employing four pre-trained models—EfficientNetB2, InceptionV3, MobileNetV3, and ResNet50—images are classified into normal, ulcerative colitis, polyps, and esophagitis categories. Public datasets like KVASIR and ETIS-Larib-Polyp DB are utilized, with the original 800 images expanded to 3,200 through data augmentation to enhance model generalization. Performance is measured using metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The results indicate that the accuracies of InceptionV3, EfficientNetB2, ResNet50, and MobileNetV3 are 94%, 93%, 89.12%, and 87%, respectively. Given its strong accuracy and resource efficiency, InceptionV3 emerges as the best-performing model, making it suitable for deployment in low-resource settings. This study highlights the potential of deep learning to provide reliable, automated tools for early colon cancer detection.

articleTitle: Linear Irrational Unit (LIU): An Activation Function For Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: In a convolutional neural network (CNN), the output is produced by passing the input through an activation function (AF). The traditional AFs like sigmoid and tanh suffer from disappearing gradient problems. The disappearing gradient issue was solved by the ReLU AF, but the negative region issue still exists. This study introduces a non-monotonic, nonlinear AF dubbed the Linear Irrational Unit (LIU). The function is continuously differentiable in both the positive and negative regions, which overcomes the disappearing gradient problem. As the proposed function has a non-zero value in the negative region, it does not suffer from the negative region problem. The effectiveness of the proposed LIU activation function was assessed using MNIST, CIFAR-10 and Chest X-ray datasets. With our proposed CNN model, the LIU activation function can reach an accuracy of 85.26% on the Chest X-ray dataset, 99.52% on the MNIST dataset, and 83.15% on the CIFAR dataset, which is better than the performance of other modern activation functions.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Virtual Try-On System: Enhancing Fit Prediction and User Comfort Through Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: The rapid growth of e-commerce in the fashion industry has fueled the demand for advanced virtual try-on solutions to enhance the client experience. However, existing systems often need to deliver precise fit prediction, comprehensive comfort analysis, and interactive precision, contributing to high return rates and low user satisfaction. This paper presents an AI-powered virtual try-on system to address these challenges by leveraging state-of-the-art deep learning and computer vision techniques. The proposed system integrates gesture-based controls for seamless interaction, real-time body tracking for enhanced accuracy, and a personalized fashion recommender utilizing prior purchase data to improve user engagement. Key innovations include using AI-generated heat maps for garment comfort assessment, achieving a fit prediction accuracy of 94.1%, and demonstrating a 20% improvement in user satisfaction compared to existing systems, as measured by survey feedback. The system also reduces computational complexity while ensuring scalability and practical applicability in real-world e-commerce scenarios. By combining intuitive design, personalization, and advanced analytics, this research establishes a robust framework for next-generation virtual try-on technologies to revolutionize the online shopping experience.

articleTitle: Solar Photovoltaic Based Reduced Multilevel Inverter Using Digital Logic Controller Based ANN Technique for Reduction of Harmonics
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: This article pioneers the solar supplied cascaded multilevel inverter, a cascaded multilevel inverter (MLI) that blends digital logic control with various level control techniques. These days, cascading multilevel are employed in a variety of application domains, including smart grid, grid-tied inverters, industrial driver applications, and charging stations for electric vehicles. The multilayer inverter's fewer switches will aid in lowering the harmonics that arise in the system when a load is connected. The Total Harmonics Distortion (THD) consequently affects the benefits of MLI by the output voltage. Topologically advance control technique is required for the MLI to satisfactory output voltage control. In this work, a different kind of DC source is fed to the Cascaded MLI from the battery source. Here the THD is compared with two methods one is conventional PWM method with 9 level and 7 level with source voltage of 48V, 96V, 196V and the output reduced THD is achieved. The overall simulation is done in MATLAB/ SIMULINK model of the proposed scheme. In the future Neural network techniques can be used for improvement of power quality.

articleTitle: Lumbar Spine MRI Images Quality Enhancement through Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Lumbar spine MRI is important for accurately diagnosing spinal issues, where the clarity and quality of images highly influence medical examinations. This work determines the effectiveness of Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) as a contrast enhancement preprocessing approach to enhance lumbar spine MRI images visualization. Considering the importance of clear and precise visualization in clinical settings, this approach is evaluated in comparison to the conventional Histogram Equalization (HE) and the Retinex Algorithm, both widely used for image enhancement. The comparison study focuses on performance metric to evaluate the quality of images, including PSNR, SSIM, EPI and CPU time. Results illustrate that CLAHE outperforms HE and the Retinex , delivering better PSNR and SSIM values, leading to greater contrast enhancement and structural feature retention as well. These findings suggest that CLAHE provides more successful preprocessing strategy for lumbar spine MRI, having great potential to increase diagnostic accuracy. Further research focuses on the integration of CLAHE with optimization techniques to improve image enhancement in medical imaging.

articleTitle: Advanced Communication Protocols: A Dual Approach with Advanced CoAP with DTLS
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: The IoT (Internet of Things) permits each real time thing to be effortlessly incorporated with conventional network. To exchange information with previous networks, the real time heterogeneous objects are improved with the ability to communicate, evaluating standards, abilities and these objects are vulnerable and resource constrained to several security protocols. Much existing research have been carried out to implement the secure protocol for safe data communication and transmission in the IoT environment. The proposed model introduces the segmented transmission CoAP (Constrained Application Protocol) with DTLS (Datagram Transport Layer Security) for safe and secure communication protocol to protect the sensitive and confidential data of the users. The proposed segmented transmission CoAP with DTLS transmit the response and request with two blocks. The client can transfer many blocks with request and server can transfer many blocks with response without any requirements. Due to this approach, the proposed segmented transmission CoAP with DTLS minimizes the risk of transmission failure segmenting messages because of the large payloads which surpass the boundaries of the network. The employment of DTLS provides a strong security layer during the process of communication which confirms the achievement of data confidentiality and integrity. Even in the unsafe networks, the proposed segmented transmission CoAP with DTLS strengthen the security characteristics of DTLS and improves the resource employment for secure transmission of confidential data. The performance of the proposed segmented transmission CoAP with DTLS model is evaluated by the performance metrics of throughput, energy consumption and latency time.

articleTitle: Design of a Standalone Hybrid Renewable Energy System - A Hospital in Lafayette, Indiana, USA
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: This paper presents the design of a standalone hybrid renewable energy system (HRES) for a hospital in Lafayette, Indiana, USA, to enhance energy reliability and reduce costs. The proposed system integrates photovoltaic (PV) panels, wind turbines, batteries, and a backup diesel generator. Using Hybrid Optimization Model for Electric Renewables (HOMER) software, the system is optimized for cost-effectiveness and sustainability, while Electrical Transient Analyzer Program (ETAP) software is employed to ensure a safe operation under varying conditions. Results verify that the developed HRES meets the hospital’s energy needs, significantly reduces operational costs, and minimizes carbon emissions, offering a sustainable model for healthcare facilities.

articleTitle: Enhanced Data Analysis by Natural Language Query Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: This project aims to empower non-technical users in conducting data analysis by enabling effortless data retrieval through natural language queries. These users often lack expertise in querying languages but require access to database-stored data. Traditional methods like SQL query templates and slot-filling techniques have limitations in coverage and understanding complex queries. Models relying on LSTM or BERT may require internet connectivity, limiting offline usability. To address these challenges, transformer-based models, specifically the CodeT5 transformer, were adopted. Unlike previous methods, CodeT5 excels in understanding and generating complex queries accurately, operating offline, and enhancing accessibility. By utilizing CodeT5 and implementing natural language processing techniques for query interpretation, significant improvements were made in the user experience in data analysis tasks. The system generates Pandas queries in Python, integrating seamlessly with Python-based data analysis workflows and supporting multiple data formats for enhanced flexibility. The system streamlines data analysis workflows and increases productivity. Users can upload data in various formats, including csv and txt, and export query results for further analysis or reporting. Its scalability allows adaptation to different databases and querying languages, such as MongoDB or MySQL, catering to diverse applications. The project demonstrated significant improvements in data analysis efficiency and acessibility. The system’s ability to generate and execute queries automatically reduces dependency on technical expertise, empowering users to extract insights from data effortlessly. With its scalability, cross-platform compatibility, and offline functionality, the system represents a significant advancement in democratizing data analysis.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on Efficiency and Output Voltage Regulation in Dual-Active Bridge Converter with SPS and TPS Modulation under Input Voltage Variations
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: The comprehensive performance characteristics of two prominent modulation techniques on Dual-Active Bridge (DAB) converter: Single Phase Shift (SPS) and Triple Phase Shift (TPS) is presented in this paper. The DAB converter topology is a promising architecture for its high-efficiency, bidirectional power conversion, galvanic isolation and flexible gating schemes. The primary objective is to evaluate the effectiveness of modulation techniques on output voltage regulation under varying input voltage conditions. Phase displacement patterns and their correlation with the varying input voltage are illustrated graphically along with the detailed results. A comprehensive design analysis is developed, followed by the detailed simulation results is showcased for a 1 kW converter in boost mode of operation. This study highlights the insights for the selection and optimization of modulation strategies for DAB converter in applications demanding precise output voltage regulation and high efficiency.

articleTitle: High-Speed, Area-Efficient Three-Operand Pipelined Adder
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: In high-speed arithmetic circuits, adder efficiency is crucial for system performance. Common adders like Carry Skip, Han-Carlson, and Kogge Stone aim to optimize delay and area but still struggle to balance speed, area, and power. This paper introduces a new three-operand pipelined adder, replacing conventional parallel prefix logic with a streamlined pipelined method. The design combines an adder and subtractor in one unit, using modular logic to handle both functions. Pipelining allows continuous data processing, increasing throughput and reducing critical path delay. This three-operand pipelined adder achieves significant area and delay improvements over traditional designs. Using fewer logic gates and connections makes the design more compact and improves its performance. Simulations and synthesis validate the proposed design's effectiveness, showing major improvements in speed and area, making it valuable for high-speed, area-limited VLSI applications.

articleTitle: Development of a Machine-Learning Model for monitoring the Friction-Stir-Welding Tool using Vibration Signatures
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Friction Stir Welding (FSW) forms high-strength welds with outstanding mechanical characteristics. FSW differs from traditional welding techniques by operating at temperatures below the melting point of the materials. Therefore, condition monitoring of the tool is essential to seamlessly utilize FSW in manufacturing and its applications. For this purpose, a machine learning model is employed. Machine learning models play a pivotal role in identifying any wear and tear in the tool by predicting failures before they occur. The process starts with collecting raw data at three different speeds (in RPM) involving real-time vibrational data. This paper is based on a histogram approach to data analysis, using machine-learning (ML) algorithms such as Random Forest, Random Subspace, Naive Bayes, Naive Bayes Multinomial, Logistic Model Tree (LMT), KStar, Logistic Regression, IBK, J48, and PART. Among all classifiers, Random Forest provides the best results.

articleTitle: Addressing Intersymbol Interference and Nonlinearity in Quadrature Amplitude Modulation Systems using Functional Link Artificial Neural Network Equalizer
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: This paper proposes Functional Link Artificial Neural Network (FLANN) based equalizers to alleviate the impacts of Intersymbol Interference (ISI) and nonlinearity in Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) corrupted digital communication systems employing 16 and 64 Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM). FLANN offers computational efficiency and does not need hidden layers which makes it an attractive alternative to conventional equalizers as well as equalizers based on Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) neural networks. This paper extends prior published work by considering the effects of nonlinearity and employing a hyperbolic tangent-based multilevel activation function tailored to the specific QAM schemes considered. The channel’s dispersive nature is modelled using a Finite Impulse Response (FIR) filter. Results clearly demonstrate the suitability of FLANN-based equalizers in mitigating channel irregularities.

articleTitle: Leveraging Deep Learning Techniques for Colon Cancer Classification from Histopathology Images
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Colorectal cancer is a common and deadly disease due to its complexity and growth. Early detection is crucial for prevention. To detect it early, tissue samples are examined under a microscope, focusing on gland structures. This has resulted in the creation of various evaluation tests to analyze images of polyps and detect colon cancer. In this study, we present an approach to identify cancer in the colon using histopathology images with deep learning algorithms, images include adenocarcinoma and benign tissues. We utilized deep learning models like CNN, ResNet101, EfficientNetB0, InceptionResNetV2, and DenseNet121 to identify colon cancer. These models were evaluated by performance metrics like Accuracy, Error rate, F1-Score, MCC, Kappa, and G-mean. InceptionResNetV2 outperforms very well with an accuracy of 97.25%, The developed model shows potential as a valuable tool to help pathologists make decisions for timely diagnoses. By integrating this model into clinical settings, it can enhance diagnostic workflows, reduce human error, and facilitate timely treatment for patients with colorectal cancer.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis in Blast Induced Ground Vibrations with Advanced Machine Learning Algorithm Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: For mining and construction, it is very important to analyze blast-induced ground vibrations because of the risks they pose, such as structural damage and environmental disturbance. Machine learning provides powerful tools for analyzing these complex, non-linear signals, allowing accurate prediction and classification of vibration patterns. Deep learning and related optimization procedures offer opportunities for improving the vibration impact assessment procedures. In the research work, the SMO algorithm is applied to perform the dimensionality reduction of piezoelectric sensors (shielded and unshielded). The reduced features are then classified using Decision Tree and Random Forest methodologies. Random Forest performs even better at 97.92% accuracy when a shielded sensor is used, as opposed to only 95.84% accuracy when an unshielded sensor is used, thus demonstrating superior overall efficiency.

articleTitle: Real-time V2V Communication Device for Enhanced Road Safety
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: This paper proposes a Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) communication system that utilizes Arduino Uno, nRF24L01 wireless transceiver, GPS Neo6m module, and an HTML/CSS/JavaScript map interface. The system enables real-time exchange of information between vehicles, allowing for enhanced safety, traffic management, and situational awareness. By integrating Arduino Uno, nRF24L01, and GPS Neo6m, and leveraging the web-based map interface, the proposed solution facilitates seamless communication and data visualization. Experimental results demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the system in supporting V2V communication

articleTitle: Detection of Ghee and Vanaspati Adulteration using Hyperspectral Imaging and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Ghee, a popular clarified butter widely consumed around the world, particularly in India, is valued for its taste and health benefits. However, some vendors adulterate it with cheaper substances such as vanaspati to increase profits, which can be harmful to consumers. This requires robust methods for quality assurance. In response to this challenge, this article presents a noninvasive method for detecting ghee adulteration with vanaspati using hyperspectral imaging (HSI). We created a data set consisting of hyperspectral images with different proportions of ghee and vanaspati. This data set was tested on various machine-learning algorithms. The results were impressive, showing a highly accurate detection of adulteration (99. 35%) with the K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) and Random Forest algorithms. These methods were quick to converge, facilitating faster results.

articleTitle: Exploring the Performance of NOMA Systems with Intelligent Surface Assistance
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: This study presents a comprehensive analysis of the Bit Error Rate (BER) performance in a Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) system enhanced by a Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface (RIS) to support uplink power domain communication. By leveraging the RIS's ability to intelligently reconfigure the wireless propagation environment, the proposed system aims to optimize spectral efficiency and enhance communication reliability. The BER performance is evaluated under various conditions, considering key factors such as channel fading, interference, and power allocation schemes. Through detailed mathematical modeling and extensive simulations, the study demonstrates that integrating RIS can substantially reduce BER, leading to more robust and efficient wireless communication. The findings suggest that RIS-enhanced NOMA systems have the potential to revolutionize future wireless communication networks by offering significant improvements in signal quality and data transmission reliability.

articleTitle: Development of High Precision Thick Film Process for Realization of Microwave Modules
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: This paper explores the application of high density gold conductor paste with capability of ultra-fine line etching for microwave frequency applications. By blending thick film technology, photolithography and etching on low-loss dielectric 99.6% Alumina substrate, ultra-fine line patterns with sizes down to 40 μm has been achieved. The study focuses on the fabrication process, detailing the optimization & fine-tuning of printing parameters to achieve high precision and reliability. Further, photolithography is employed to define intricate patterns with fine feature sizes, ensuring minimal signal loss and maintaining the integrity of microwave signals. By implementing this technology, high-performance filters ranging from the C-band to the Ku-band are realized. The performance of the fabricated circuits is evaluated in terms of conductivity, adhesion, and microwave frequency response. The performance of the filters is promising and demonstrate that this technology offers performance comparable to that of Thin Film technology. Results indicate that the combination of ultra-fine line conductor paste with advanced printing and photolithography techniques on alumina substrate offers a viable solution for microwave components, providing enhanced signal fidelity and potential miniaturization. This approach paves the way for advancements in microwave communication systems, sensor technologies, and other high-frequency applications.

articleTitle: Smart Solar Panel Monitoring and Fault Identification using IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Solar photovoltaic is one of the popular renewable technologies. The reliability of solar system mainly depends on the operation and maintenance which requires continuous monitoring of solar panels. This project focuses on the development and implementation of a smart solar monitoring and fault identification system using IoT technology. The system utilizes a combination of sensors, microcontroller and wireless communication to collect critical data such as voltage, temperature, humidity and other parameters. This data is then analyzed to plot Voltage-Current (V-I) and Power-Voltage (P-V) characteristics, identify performance issues and hence detect faults such as open circuit, short circuit and shading effects. An algorithm is developed for ESP32 microcontroller equipped with built-in Wi-Fi capabilities, that facilitates seamless data transmission to a remote server for centralized monitoring and analysis. Overall, the smart solar monitoring system offers a comprehensive solution for optimizing solar PV system performance and advancing renewable energy technologies.

articleTitle: Analysis of Supply Chain Attacks in Open-Source Software and Mitigation Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Supply Chain Attacks, particularly those exploiting the extensive implementation of open-source software and libraries have continued to compromise the security of enterprise applications. The exploit discovered in the XZ Utils Software further pushes the discussion for more effective strategies for the mitigation of such risks. This paper delves into the security incident in detail and provides an in-depth analysis of mitigation strategies in place to prevent such attacks in heavily integrated systems implementing open-source software. The study emphasizes the importance of establishing robust software provenance verification mechanisms. Additionally, it highlights the necessity of collaboration between organizations to share threat intelligence and proactively address vulnerabilities.

articleTitle: Emotion Classification to Augment the Emotional Intelligence of Autistic Individuals
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: The collaboration of machine learning (ML) algorithms and cognitive psychological frameworks supports the enhancement of emotional intelligence. In light of Plutchik's emotional wheel, this study investigates how to identify human emotions. By utilizing 24 different emotions, 8 high-intensive (secondary) emotions are identified. We employed 9 different classification algorithms K-nearest neighbors (KNN), decision trees (DT), naïve bayes (NB), support vector machine (SVM), Logistic regression, random forest (RF), artificial neural network (ANN), gradient boosting machines (GBM), and bagging classifier (BC) to identify the emotions accurately and the performance of them are compared. This research uses the labelled dataset consisting of 11 columns as similar word 1, similar word 2, typical sensation 1, typical sensation 2, opposite intensity low, opposite intensity medium, opposite intensity high, tells, helps, emotion and cluster.

articleTitle: Hidden Emotion Detection using Speech, Text, Facial Expressions and Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Understanding and recognition of human emotions are very crucial in various fields. This paper proposes a new approach to show the different feelings that are hidden using multi-modalities like video, audio, and textual data. A custom dataset AED-FST has been used in this work which has nearly 317 samples each consisting of some audio clip, some visual media, and a question-and-answer pair. From all these entirely diverse sources, the goal is to create a model that could possibly detect emotional cues. It found hidden emotions with a 67% accuracy, representing how well it could pick up on these weak cues from all different modalities. This method contributes immensely to emotion detection in extremely wide fields, including psychological diagnoses and human-computer interaction, to mention just a few.

articleTitle: IoT-based Heart Health Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: The number of cases of cardiovascular illness has been on the rise for a long time. The proposed solution aims to address this issue using a system equipped with the Internet of Things (IoT) to monitor the user’s heart rate and send a real-time alert and updates. The solution aims to integrate a pulse sensor connected to Arduino UNO, through which the user’s heart rate is transmitted wirelessly to a user-friendly Graphical User Interface(GUI) created using Python’s Tkinter library. The data is transmitted using the Message Queuing Telemetry Transport(MQTT) protocol. Through this, the user information is sent to the backend of the application. Since this solution involves critical information, data privacy, and security is maintained using Advanced Encryption Standard-256(AES-256). The system implements a machine learning (ML) algorithm to predict heart attack risk using heart rate and only static features and notify the user of any abnormality in near real-time. The solution is proposed to be integrated into a digital watch, offer accessibility in remote areas, and alert the user instantly when there is a cardiovascular risk.

articleTitle: Enhancing Breast Cancer Classification through Attention Based VGG-19 and Federated Learning with Multi-Center Medical Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Breast cancer remains the primary cause of death for women worldwide, which emphasises how important it is to detect the disease early and accurately in order to increase survival rates. Conventional approaches encounter substantial challenges since large labelled datasets are required, and they are frequently limited by privacy issues and dispersed data sources. This work introduces an novel method to improve breast cancer classification by combining Attention-based VGG-19 with Federated Learning in multi-center medical imaging. Accurate breast cancer detection relies on analyzing medical images such as mammograms, MRIs, and biopsies, which often vary across different healthcare centers. The proposed model uses VGG-19, a deep convolutional neural network, enhanced with an attention mechanism to highlight key regions in the images for more precise classification. Federated Learning is also integrated, enabling multiple medical institutions to collaboratively train the model without sharing sensitive patient data, thereby preserving privacy and data security. This approach allows the model to learn from diverse datasets while keeping the data localized. The synergy of attention-based VGG-19 and Federated Learning enhances the accuracy, robustness, and generalization of breast cancer classification, offering a promising solution for early detection and diagnosis across multiple medical centres.

articleTitle: YOLOv8-Powered Multi-Object Detection for Safety Helmets and Number Plates in Real-Time Surveillance Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: This paper presents a real-time object detection system using the latest YOLOv8 model to enhance traffic monitoring and safety enforcement. The model was trained to detect helmets, riders and number plates in diverse traffic scenarios, achieving an overall accuracy of 93.4%. Significant improvements were observed in precision, recall and mean Average Precision (mAP) scores due to the combination of an optimized architecture, high-quality data and fine-tuned hyperparameters. The system maintains real-time inference capabilities with a processing speed of 11 ms per image, making it suitable for continuous surveillance and enforcement applications. This study demonstrates the potential of using advanced deep learning techniques for effective and automated traffic rule enforcement. Future work may involve further optimizations and integration with large-scale cloud-based systems for more comprehensive deployments.

articleTitle: A Pick and Place Mechanism with Vision to Sort Objects of Different Colour and Size
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: The traditional pick and place mechanisms in manufacturing and automation often lack adaptability, precision, and cost-effectiveness, when handling objects of different sizes and colours. This paper describes an innovative pick and place system that employs vision sensors to enhance the size and colour detection capabilities. The proposed system utilises a pre-trained monocular depth detection model along with a custom-made size detection algorithm that can measure object's dimensions accurately without having to resort to stereo vision systems. For colour detection, we adopted HSV colour space to ensure strong operation even under different lighting scenarios. A smart phone camera is used as a vision sensor to test the performance of the system. It is demonstrated that the proposed system greatly increases the pick and place machine's efficiency and versatility, thereby making it more appropriate for today’s fast-changing industrial settings.

articleTitle: Malware Detection in Image Data: A Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Malware is constantly changing in today’s digital environment, posing a rising danger to global cybersecurity. With the sheer amount and complexity of new malware, traditional detection techniques that frequently rely on signature-based approaches are finding it more and more difficult to keep up. To solve this problem, this study uses deep learning algorithms to detect malware hidden within images. The demand for quicker and more precise detection techniques is what spurred this research. The first step in the procedure is to put together a dataset that contains pictures of malware and innocuous content. We investigated image augmentation methods to increase the variety of the dataset. Next, using the processed dataset, a convolutional neural network (CNN) was created and trained. To guarantee a thorough assessment, pre-trained models such as VGGNet and ResNet were employed for comparison. 3813 images comprise the dataset used in this study; 2288 of those are training images, and the rest are divided into two halves as testing and validation images. With a detection accuracy of 97.38%, the trained model proved its capacity to identify images as either malware or non-malware. By offering a deep learning- based method for malware identification in images, this work advances the field of cybersecurity. It may make it easier to develop detection algorithms that are quicker and more accurate.

articleTitle: Advanced Diabetic Retinopathy Classification Using Context-Gated Dilated Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is the leading cause of global vision impairment, requires accurate and early detection. The main challenge in DR classification is improving feature extraction and classification accuracy. To overcome this context, a lightweight feature extraction is required. This paper presents a Context-Gated Dilated Convolution Network (CGDCN) to categorize DR phases from retinal images efficiently. The proposed CGDCN has five gated-dilated convolutional layers that extract complex features, a pooling layer that reduces spatial dimensions while retaining critical features, and a fully connected layer for final classification into five DR stages. Context-aware modules in gated-dilated convolutional layers is used. These modules calculate feature map mean intensity and modify feature extraction paths with gating signals. To enhance the network’s capacity to capture small details and contextual information using the suggested algorithm. Finally, the CGDCN framework uses context-aware gating methods and dilated convolutions to detect DR with high precision. The proposed CGDCN architecture achieved significantly higher accuracy (98.178%) and lower loss (0.060) compared to the ResNet50 model (88.73% accuracy and 1.3003 loss) for diabetic retinopathy classification, demonstrating its superior performance and efficiency

articleTitle: Design of a Simplified Floating Point Adder for Complex Computation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: A new highly efficient floating-point adder/subtractor has been refined to enhance the efficiency of both addition and subtraction processes. This design emphasizes a streamlined architecture for quick computation with power efficiency. One important feature of this adder/subtractor is its simplified structure that enhances floating-point arithmetic and reduces power consumption. Despite including a subtraction circuitry, the compact design makes it suitable for high-performance computing environments. Such an adder/subtractor is essential in financial modelling as it processes vast amounts of complicated numerical data to predict market trends. It also serves scientific research by providing trustworthy and effective arithmetic solutions thus enabling data analysis and simulations. The power consumption goes down by 4.153W, the LUT (area) goes down to 189, and computational efficiency increases tremendously compared to traditional methods. This versatility, better performance, and power efficiency make the design valuable to different industries, which offer benefits such as reduced topology complexity and optimized mathematical manipulations.

articleTitle: Leveraging Hybrid Deep Learning Approaches for Effective Sickle Cell Anemia Diagnosis from Microscopic Images
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Sickle cell anaemia is a critical inherited blood abnormality affecting millions worldwide, requiring accurate and timely detection for effective management. This study explores the utilization of advanced DL approaches to enhance the detection of SCA in microscopic images, aiming to improve diagnostic precision and efficiency. The research involves preprocessing image data and training seven cutting-edge models: DenseNet-201, ResNet-152, Xception, MobileNet, DenseNet-201+ResNet-152, Xception+ MobileNetV2, and a comprehensive model combining DenseNet-201, ResNet-152, Xception, and MobileNet. These models are evaluated using key performance metrics, including accuracy, error rate, Jaccard score, MCC, F1-score, Kappa, and G-Mean. The study identifies the most effective model for practical application, emphasizing its potential for real-world clinical use. By providing an automated approach to early SCA detection, this research seeks to advance haematological diagnostics, improve patient care and streamline healthcare processes.

articleTitle: Enhanced Feature Fusion Techniques for Acute Leukemia Detection in Microscopic Blood Cells
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Medical image segmentation thus assumes a major role in identifying anomalies in microscopic blood cell images for the detection of acute leukemia and other blood disorders. Traditional approaches require experts of domain-specific knowledge and need manual intervention to segment the images. For the detection of acute leukemia using multi-scale feature fusion, an advanced deep learning framework known as FusionNet is introduced in this study. Key to Advanced FusionNet is an adapted encoder-decoder architecture with attention mechanisms that use fused multi-scale contextual information to obtain high-accuracy segmentation. Modified feature fusion methods using Convolutional Neural Networks drive the proposed model toward improving its accuracy. Experimental evaluations make use of Kaggle's available public datasets for all tests to showcase the performance of Advanced FusionNet. Compared to traditional segmentation techniques and existing deep learning models, the model exceeds an accuracy of 90% and a precision of 92%. In addition, recall and F1-Score metrics of 88% and 89%, respectively, are also calculated to further validate the robustness in detecting leukemia-related abnormalities. Such is the contribution of the study in advancing medical image analysis, proposing Advanced FusionNet for the detection of acute leukemia microscopic blood cell images, and underlining the vitality of feature fusion methods in improving segmentation accuracy for clinical applications.

articleTitle: Optimizing Lightweight Cryptographic Protocols for Secure Communication in Internet of Things(IoT) Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has significantly reshaped technological advancements, integrating a wide range of devices into a unified ecosystem. This interconnected network extends across various sectors, from everyday household gadgets to sophisticated industrial equipment, enabling seamless data exchange and automation. However, the exponential growth of IoT devices introduces critical vulnerabilities, as many devices are inherently resource-constrained and unable to support conventional security mechanisms effectively. This paper presents a novel lightweight cryptographic protocol designed for secure communication in resource- constrained IoT devices. The protocol combines Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) with an optimized symmetric encryption scheme to ensure data confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity while minimizing computational overhead. The proposed protocol is evaluated against common cryptographic attacks and analyzed for its efficiency in terms of computational complexity and energy consumption.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Approach: Predicting Critical Braking Temperature in Train Wheels Using Fiber Bragg Grating Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: This research presents a novel approach to predicting the critical temperature at which brakes must be applied to train wheels, combining real-time data collection through Fiber Bragg Grating (FBG) sensors with advanced machine learning models. While previous studies have either focused on theoretical models or utilized real-time sensor data without predictive capabilities, our approach uniquely integrates both sensor data and predictive modeling to improve accuracy. Conducted at The Oxford College of Engineering, our experiment used a scaled-down train model to measure key parameters such as speed, weight, and temperature during braking. Unlike traditional models, our study employed machine learning algorithms, including Linear Regression, Decision Tree, and Random Forest, to forecast the critical braking temperature. The Random Forest model significantly outperformed other models, achieving a perfect R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> score of 1.00 and a Mean Squared Error (MSE) of 0.00. Our integrated approach not only enhances the precision of braking temperature predictions but also offers a robust framework for predictive maintenance, improving the operational safety and efficiency of rail systems. This research marks a significant step forward in real-time monitoring and predictive analytics for rail transport systems, providing a superior method for detecting and responding to critical thermal conditions.

articleTitle: Enhancing Dynamic Spectrum Access in Wireless Mesh Networks: Integrated Sensing and Channel Assignment
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: This study advances Channel Assignment (CA) strategies in wireless mesh networks that integrate Wi-Fi with Dynamic Spectrum Access (DSA). We propose critical modifications to the IEEE 802.11 standard to enhance spectrum sensing data reporting, which is crucial for efficient network resource management. Specifically, we introduce two novel measurement types – avgSINR and SINRCI – and detail their integration into network protocols to optimise CA. Furthermore, we outline robust procedures for the dynamic distribution and adjustment of CAs, ensuring rapid network adaptation. Our findings demonstrate that the network can rapidly converge on a new CA within 10 minutes, even in extensive networks comprising 100 nodes, thereby significantly enhancing operational efficiency and spectrum utilisation.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Age and Gender Prediction through Feature Extraction from Facial Images using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: In recent years, age estimation and gender classification have been focal points in the field of pattern recognition and computer vision. This paper introduces an automated approach for predicting age and gender by extracting features from human facial images. In contrast to conventional methods that operate on unfiltered facial images, our study demonstrates significant improvements in these tasks through the use of deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The employed feedforward neural network method enhances robustness for highly variable unconstrained recognition tasks, specifically targeting gender identification and age group estimation. The research methodology involves the analysis and validation of gender prediction and age estimation on two benchmark datasets: the Essex face dataset and the Adience benchmark dataset. Results indicate a substantial performance enhancement, showcasing the proposed approach's efficiency and state-of-the-art performance in both age and gender detection. The model achieves remarkable accuracy, positioning it as a notable advancement in the realm of age and gender prediction using deep learning techniques.

articleTitle: Advanced Power Electronics Interface for Designing Electric Vehicle Charging Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: The transportation industry’s electrification transformation is happening very quickly. Car manufacturers are reacting to consumer and societal demands for carbon-neutral technology that enables sustainable transportation by aggressively pursuing comprehensive electrification projects for their vehicle fleets. Power electronics technology is rapidly advancing and plays a vital part in this revolutionary journey. Although some of the newer technologies have matured, these systems' electrical complexity necessitates excellent reliability. As a result, the focus of this paper is on assessing the dependability of the power electronic systems used in both electric vehicles (EVs) and hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs). It describes the unique needs for dependability and the difficulties that come with using power electronics in EV applications. The paper delves into additional detail on developments in power electronic components meant to solve reliability issues, considering each component’s unique contributions to the overall reliability of the system. We examine a reliability-oriented design technique and give real-world examples, such as the drive train inverter and an EV onboard charger. Finally, the paper provides an overview of future directions for research on EV/HEV power electronics dependability like design and testing, monitoring control, simulation of components and component technology. Even while many areas of reliability have been successfully addressed, the emergence of completely new technologies emphasizes how crucial it is to continue to keep reliability as a top priority.

articleTitle: Mobility Management in 5G Heterogeneous Networks: A Scheme for Reducing Handover Failures
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Mobile/cellular communication has become very popular in recent decades and has evolved considerably. Cellular communications are shifting towards heterogeneous inter-connectivity. Ultra-dense heterogeneous networks (HetNets) employing small cells (SCs) within a macro cell's coverage area represent a highly promising strategy for boosting both capacity and coverage in 5G cellular networks. An ultra-dense network (UDN) refers to a setup where the number of Radio Access Technologies (RATs) present in a specific geographic location is increased. An ultra-dense network (UDN) is a setup in which the number of Radio Access Technologies (RATs) in a given geographic area is enhanced. As a result, the areas covered by each RAT start to overlap. Small base stations (SBSs) are situated close together in a UDN. Consequently, a single user equipment (UE) might pick up signals from multiple SBS, leading to significant inter-cell interference. This scenario typically arises due to a delayed handover. In environments with densely packed small cells, inter-cell interference is prevalent, causing deterioration in signal quality and subpar service for users. In this respect, we deal with mobility management from the point of view of users' mobility support in multi-RAT and multi-layer environments. We aim to reduce handover failures due to the unavailability of resources at the target base station (BS)/cell/RAT. We implemented a handover strategy that lowers the number of dropped handover calls by using a semi-Markov mobility prediction algorithm for handover control. This allows for the reservation of resources in the destination base station ahead of time, considerably reducing the amount of handover failures. The suggested scheme's findings were validated using a MATLAB simulation of an environment containing tiny cells with various radio access methods. According to the simulation results, predicting the next position of the user equipment resulted in lesser handover call dropping as opposed to new call blocking because they were not expected and thus resources were not prepared for them.

articleTitle: BOA: Optimizing Energy Usage in Cloud-Fog Environment Using Meta-Heuristic Scheduling Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Optimizing energy consumption in Cloud-Fog Computing (CFC) environments is essential for enhancing efficiency and sustainability. In this paper we propose a Meta-Heuristic (MH) scheduling algorithm based on the Butterfly Optimization Algorithm (BOA) to effectively manage resource allocation and Task Scheduling (TS) between CFC. The proposed approach aims to minimize energy consumption, while improving throughput and optimizing resource utilization. Through simulation results, the BOA-based algorithm demonstrates a reduction in energy consumption by 15.6%, an increase in throughput by 18.4%, and an enhancement in resource utilization by 20.8%, compared to existing scheduling algorithms. These improvements make the BOA a promising solution for energy-efficient and performance-enhancing task scheduling in cloud-fog environments, contributing to more sustainable and responsive systems for processing large-scale, distributed workloads.

articleTitle: Advanced Malware Detection Methods for Polymorphic Virus Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Polymorphic viruses pose a significant challenge to traditional malware detection methods due to their ability to modify their code structure with each infection, effectively evading signature-based detection. This paper explores advanced malware detection methods tailored for identifying polymorphic viruses, focusing on the integration of machine learning, deep learning and hybrid approaches. Through a comprehensive analysis of static and dynamic features extracted from executables and URLs, this study employs classifiers such as Random Forests and Support Vector Machines (SVMs) to enhance detection accuracy. The SVM classifier demonstrated superior performance, achieving a detection accuracy of 96.23% compared to the 93.67% accuracy of the Random Forest classifier. This research highlights the potential of combining static and dynamic analysis with machine learning techniques to address the limitations of traditional methods, offering a robust framework for detecting and mitigating polymorphic and zero-day threats.

articleTitle: A Multi-Classifier Approach to Landslide Susceptibility Mapping Using Geospatial Data and Machine Learning in the Ghats Regions of Karnataka
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Landslides pose a significant threat to life, infrastructure and the environment in the Western Ghats region of Karnataka. This study develops a comprehensive Landslide Susceptibility Mapping (LSM) model by integrating machine learning algorithms Random Forest, CART, Naive Bayes and Support Vector Machine (SVM) with remote sensing and geospatial data. The model incorporates critical geographic and environmental factors such as slope, aspect, elevation and rainfall to predict landslide susceptibility across six districts: Kodagu, Shimoga, Chikkamagaluru, Uttara Kannada, Dakshina Kannada and Udupi. The Random Forest model demonstrated the highest accuracy (94.2%) in predicting landslide-prone areas. Results indicate that Shimoga, Chikkamagaluru and Uttara Kannada have higher susceptibility, particularly in the Moderate and High categories, underscoring the need for targeted mitigation strategies. This study highlights the effectiveness of machine learning in geohazard mapping and provides a scalable approach that can be adapted for other regions vulnerable to landslides.

articleTitle: Enhanced Pseudorandom Number Generation using Mersenne-LFSR Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Pseudorandom number generators (PRNGs) are fundamental tools in various applications, including cryptography, simulation and statistical sampling. Traditional PRNGs often face challenges related to periodicity, randomness quality, and computational efficiency. This paper presents the Mersenne LFSR fusion, an innovative approach that combines the Linear Feedback Shift Register (LFSR) and Mersenne Twister algorithms. By integrating the fast and simple structure of the LFSR with the high-quality randomness and long period of the Mersenne Twister, this method significantly improves PRNG performance. Experimental analysis shows that the Mersenne-LFSR fusion has superior randomness properties and longer period compared to traditional methods. The robustness of the fusion counter was validated through a scrambler-descrambler application, which effectively encoded and decoded data without introducing patterns. These enhancements make the proposed model a strong contender for applications that demand high-quality pseudorandom number sequences. Despite its superior performance, the Mersenne LFSR fusion has a limitation of higher power consumption, which may be a consideration in power-constrained environments. Nevertheless, it offers significant improvements in security and reliability, exceeding standard benchmarks for modern computing needs.

articleTitle: Road Accident Detection and Alert System at Real-Time Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: This paper presents a real-time road accident detection and alert system that leverages a custom sequential CNN model optimized for rapid accident identification. Unlike existing approaches, this method integrates an automated alert system through Telegram’s API, ensuring immediate notification to emergency responders. This enhancement significantly reduces response time, allowing for faster intervention and potentially saving lives. A convolutional neural network (CNN) model has been developed using frames extracted from CCTV video footage of accidents and non-accidents. The frames are processed and classified into an accident and non-accident categories for training the model to assess the incoming frames of a video in real-time. The data preprocessing, model selection, training, model validation, and performance assessment against benchmarks resulted in an efficient and accurate CNN-based accident detection system. It analyses live or recorded videos of the scene and determines whether an accident is present in the frame. In case of high confidence in an accident across multiple frames in succession, the system takes a picture in that frame, logs the time and location details, and then sends an alert message containing the time, location coordinates, and details of the accident to a specific Telegram channel through the Telegram Bot API. This monitoring method makes it easier to analyze the occurrence of an accident and report it within a short period.

articleTitle: Enhancing Document Retrieval Using AI and Graph-Based RAG Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a potent method for enhancing the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by integrating them with external knowledge sources. While traditional RAG models rely heavily on textual similarity for retrieval, often leading to issues like context drift and hallucinations, graph-based RAG offers a more sophisticated approach. By representing documents and their relationships within a graph structure, graph-based RAG enables more context-aware retrieval, reducing hallucinations, and facilitating multi-hop reasoning. This abstract provides an overview of the RAG landscape, contrasting traditional and graph-based approaches, and highlights the advantages of graph-based RAG in addressing the limitations of traditional methods. The application of graph-based RAG to various domains, such as question answering, dialogue systems, and recommendation systems, is also explored. The abstract concludes by emphasizing the potential of graph-based RAG to revolutionize information access and retrieval in diverse AI applications.

articleTitle: Morphological Classification of Galaxies using Enhanced Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Galaxies in astrophysics are one of its fundamental, their morphological classification remains an essential key to unlock countless doors about the structure, formation and history of our Universe. For nearly a century, astronomers have assigned galaxies to perceptual categories such as ellipticals, spirals and irregulars. However, the extraordinary expansion of the galaxy database catalysed and instigated by sky surveys of ever-increasing scales rendered this classification more manual than practical. Because of the learning capability and its scaling nature, to learn hierarchical abstract features from the visual data Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) are powerful tools to recognize complex patterns and structures in images, such as spiral arms or central bulges that contribute significantly to accurate morphological classification. That is why CNN are particularly well suited to the problem of galaxy classification. While traditional classification work used to solve the problem, it is not feasible for today's huge amounts of generated data. This attempt to build and train a CNN model using galaxy images as our domain. The Enhanced CNN model can achieve the high accuracy to morphological type of galaxies. The Enhanced CNN increase both efficiency and classification accuracy, particularly when processing large dataset. The Galaxy Zoo dataset indicated that our study can provide a tool for other astronomical research in future. The Enhanced CNN gain the overall accuracy rate are 95.29% with the performance indicator were calculated including average precision, recall, F1-score and Area under curve (AUC) is 0.9513, 0.9531, 0.9525 and 0.9853 respectively. The Enhanced CNN outperforms the various existing state-of-the models.

articleTitle: Impact of Ant Colony Optimization on Optimal Routing for Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Using biologically inspired approaches has bonus advantages in offering optimal message distribution for vehicular ad hoc networks (VANETs). Bio-motivated approaches are motivated by the natural behavior of biological entities such as bees and insects. Ant colony optimization (ACO) is the optimal bio-inspired style, suitable for offering optimal routing in VANETs. The communication pattern of ACO and VANETs is similar, such as ants of ACO apply indirect communication among ants for the exchange of information, and VANETs require cooperative routing techniques for message exchange. The goal of the Bio-motivated approach is to attain proficient and accessible communication in a VANET, where vehicles turn as nodes and animatedly form a system to interchange information. In this context, the proposed work discusses the effectiveness and benefits of using a bio-inspired approach such as ACO for VANETs. To demonstrate ACO, a healthcare scenario is considered. In the healthcare system, efficient communication is required between emergency vehicles and hospitals to offer optimal treatment for patients. This work applies ACO to find the optimal path for sending an alarm to the nearest hospital from the emergency vehicle to arrange necessary things to treat patients. Using ACO increases the efficiency of the routing mechanism in all aspects such as throughput, overhead, data delivery, low latency, route discovery time, route repair time, convergence speed, and stagnation issue.

articleTitle: Random Selection for Cloud-Based Load-Distributing in Varied P2P Networks using Enhanced Throttled Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: A peer-to-peer network connection is essential to most computer users' daily activities. On heterogeneous P2P networks, maintaining cloud-based load balance is a difficult goal to achieve. Several previous research have provided load rearrangement procedures for additional load diversions, and load division on the point where the original peer arrives. The goal of cloud-based load-sharing in P2P structures is to evenly distribute the burden among net nodes, then it is not effective in efficiently removing traffic that is already happening on the P2P network's routes. By removing the traffic flow and consuming the Random Selection Load Balancing (RSLB) method and the Incredible Store Model, the behaviors in this study are characterized. Using an improved throttled method, the Incredible Store Model is examined to broaden the effects of node variety in addition to agitation toward the capacity circulation in P2P systems. Now different from the current load distribution balancing strategy, the presentation of the Random Selection Load Balancing (RSLB) technique by the Incredible Store Model decreases the network traffic flow pathways with little cloud rate of P2P. By combining the burden in the P2P net system, an investigative and observed conclusion delivers a destruction-free system with information calculated. Peer failure probability in addition to traffic control effectiveness is used to estimate the presentation of the random selection load assessment.

articleTitle: A Low-Latency Memory Architecture using 3D XPoint and Memristor Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Latency bottlenecks in modern memory hierarchies pose significant challenges for contemporary computing systems, particularly in domains such as AI and real-time processing. Traditional memory technologies like DRAM and SRAM are approaching their scalability limits. Emerging memory technologies, including Memristors and 3D XPoint, offer a promising avenue for reducing these bottlenecks. This paper presents a comprehensive architectural analysis of a memory hierarchy integrating these emerging technologies, evaluating latency, power efficiency, and cache performance through detailed simulation using gem5. We simulate multiple workloads to demonstrate how these technologies substantially improve memory performance, energy efficiency, and scalability. Our results show an average latency reduction of 37% and energy savings of up to 52% compared to traditional architectures, with some workloads experiencing improvements of up to 60% in both metrics. We demonstrate a 10°C reduction in peak temperature and 46% decrease in power density compared to traditional DRAM-based systems, while achieving a 2.3× improvement in Mean Time To Failure (MTTF). Furthermore, we provide an in-depth analysis of the scalability and potential limitations of the proposed architecture, offering insights into the future of memory hierarchies and their impact on overall system performance.

articleTitle: EFO: Resource Aware Scheduling Model for Cloud Computing Using Meta-Heuristic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Efficient resource management is critical for ensuring optimal task scheduling in cloud environments, where diverse and fluctuating workloads demand dynamic solutions. This paper presents a novel Resource-Aware Scheduling approach leveraging the Electric Fish Optimization Algorithm (EFOA) to enhance scheduling performance in cloud computing. The proposed algorithm simulates the electric field navigation mechanism of electric fish, facilitating effective exploration and exploitation in large search spaces. EFOA optimizes task allocation by considering key parameters such as resource utilization, makespan, energy consumption, and throughput. Comparative analysis demonstrates that EFOA outperforms traditional algorithms, improving resource utilization by 21.2%, reducing energy consumption by 16%, and minimizing makespan by 19.6%. The proposed algorithm is especially effective in handling heterogeneous workloads and resource-intensive cloud applications, ensuring both cost efficiency and system reliability.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Bone Age Prediction Using VGG16: An Attention-Driven Approach for Pediatric Radiograph Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: The research proposes a deep learning model based on the VGG16 CNN for the estimation of bone age using radiographs of the hand. The model performs age regression in low-resolution radiographs (384×384) with several data augmentation techniques and an integrated attention mechanism that enhances the accuracy of the model. Furthermore, the dataset was divided into age groups to classify and evaluate the model. The model is trained based on these categories. The best performance of the proposed model was an overall classification accuracy of 95%. Overall, the model precision, recall, and F1-scores were above 94% across different age categories of interest. For example, the precision ranges from 0.94 to 0.97, and recall also ranges from 0.94 to 0.97 across the age ranges. An attention mechanism was employed, improving the ability of the model to narrow its focus on relevant regions of the radiographs, hence contributing a lot to the resultant high accuracy. The training process has shown quite steady improvement in both training and validation loss with a similar MAE. Considering the low resolution of images which the model dealt with, good performance of mean absolute error could be achieved at 14.48 months, hence being good enough for bone age prediction. Further work on higher-resolution images with advanced normalization techniques needs to be done to improve this model.

articleTitle: IoT-based Smart University Using MQTT Protocol: A Scalable and Sustainable Design Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: Recently, we were moving to transform our day-to-day lives into smart environments. This can exploit many technologies, especially IoT system technology, which covers diverse applications in this era. This system interconnects all possible physical things that have the capability of performing computation, processing, storage, and communication with other smart devices. During all actions, it would require an efficient and scalable design structure to perform fast processing and communication without any latency. This paper is mainly targeted at automating various manual activities inside the university campus blocks using the most recent technology, like Arduino, Raspberry Pi, Node-Red, Mosquitto MQTT Broker, NoSQL databases, and Grafana open-source tools. As a result, we will establish a scalable and sustainable design architecture for smart environments through enhanced control and connectivity.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Smart Lake Fire Detection and Alarming System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: The Smart Lake Fire Prevention System addresses the critical need for enhanced fire prevention in lakeside environments, which are increasingly vulnerable to fires due to both natural and human-induced factors. Traditional fire detection methods often fall short in providing an immediate and scaled response, leading to potential delays in extinguishing fires. Given that time is of the essence, a more efficient and cost-effective system is required—one that can promptly alert and initiate swift action to safeguard both the environment and the communities in arid regions. The system uses strategically placed temperature and smoke sensors to monitor environmental conditions in real time. A microcontroller with Wi-Fi or GSM capabilities collects data and sends it via the MQTT protocol to AWS IoT Core. AWS Lambda analyzes the data to detect fire risks based on predefined thresholds. If a risk is identified, alerts are sent through Amazon SNS via SMS notifications to relevant authorities for rapid response. The system effectively tracks environmental conditions and transmits data to the cloud via AWS IoT Core. Testing confirmed its ability to detect fire hazards and send reliable SMS notifications through AWS SNS, all while being easy to deploy. Its scalable design allows for additional sensors, enhancing monitoring across larger lakeside areas. This cost-effective, time-efficient system simplifies traditional fire detection, providing rapid alerts and supporting firefighting efforts. Overall, it significantly advances the protection of natural ecosystems and public safety through IoT-enabled cloud solutions.

articleTitle: Triple Layer Cyber Security Model for Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: The paper presents a comprehensive approach to fortifying digital assets against sophisticated cyber threats. Combining Machine Learning (ML), reputation-based analysis, and signature-based detection, the model offers a proactive defence mechanism to identify and mitigate anomalies effectively. Traditional security measures often fail to detect evolving threats, highlighting the need for more sophisticated cybersecurity countermeasures. Anomaly detection plays a pivotal role in identifying deviations from normal behaviour, aiding intrusion detection and bolstering overall cybersecurity posture. The model’s adaptability and sophistication address the dynamic nature of cyber threats, providing organizations with a robust defence strategy. This paper has also discussed future enhancements in ML algorithms, integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies, and scalability considerations.

articleTitle: A Reliable Real-Time Traffic Sign Detection Model for Diverse Environmental Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: This paper presents the development and evaluation of the Real-Time Traffic Sign Detection Model (RTTSDM), lever-aging the YOLOv4 framework with a CSPDarknet53 backbone, trained on the German Traffic Sign Recognition Benchmark (GTSRB) dataset. The RTTSDM exhibits significant advancements in traffic sign detection, showing substantial improvements across key performance metrics including average Intersection over Union (IoU), precision, recall, F1 Score, and mean Average Precision (mAP) throughout training. Notably, the model achieves a peak mAP of 0.9685 at iteration 4000, reflecting its superior ability to accurately identify and classify traffic signs. The model demonstrates robust performance under various lighting conditions, effectively detecting prohibitory, danger, mandatory, and priority signs with high accuracy. The RTTSDM shows strong potential to improve road safety and traffic management through its precise and reliable traffic sign detection capabilities.

articleTitle: Grid Based Reliable Routing Algorithm with Energy Efficient in Wireless Sensor Networks Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Communication, Computing & Industry 6.0 (C2I6)
abstract: In the research community, dependable data transmission implementation is still a necessity in wireless sensor networks. Cluster routing is notable for its minimal overhead and reliable data transferring in traditional sensor wireless networks, greedy and perimeter forwarding have not yet been used to fully realize this potential for providing effective route alternatives in the setting of barriers and voids. This study presents a new Grid-Based Reliable Routing method.
